one_line: Personified as the wise sage who codifies Kashmir’s sacred geography and rituals along the Vitasta.

appearance.age_look: mid-40s, lean and slightly ascetic yet sturdy build
appearance.face: oval face, light brown Kashmiri complexion with a calm, scholarly gaze; sharp nose, neatly trimmed short beard and moustache, faint forehead lines; default expression is serene and focused, as if quietly explaining something important.
appearance.hair: straight, dark brown hair pulled back into a low, tidy knot at the nape; a simple off-white woolen headband wraps around the head just above the knot, leaving the top of the head uncovered.
appearance.costume: He wears a knee-length Kashmiri wool choga-style robe in muted saffron-orange, wrapped left-over-right and tied at the waist with a dark brown wool sash; under it, a cream-colored long-sleeved tunic shows at the collar and cuffs; his lower garment is a loose, ankle-length off-white cotton dhoti-style wrap, neatly folded and modest; over the shoulders a soft, slate-grey wool shawl with a subtle thin border in indigo blue drapes diagonally across his torso, one end hanging to mid-thigh; his feet are in simple dark brown leather strap sandals; the textiles are plain with very minimal pattern—only a fine geometric line border on the shawl and cuffs, suggesting local Kashmiri craft without ornate luxury.
appearance.signature: A rolled and partially unrolled palm-leaf manuscript tied with a thin indigo cord, held in his left hand, its edges slightly darkened, symbolizing the Nilamata Purana as codified sacred knowledge.

ref_desc: A mid-40s Kashmiri sage with an oval light-brown face, dark brown hair in a low knot with off-white headband, wearing a saffron choga, cream tunic, off-white dhoti, slate-grey indigo-bordered shawl and brown sandals, holding a palm-leaf manuscript in saffron, cream, grey, indigo and brown tones.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style Kashmiri sage personifying the Nilamata Purana: a mid-40s, lean man with an oval light-brown face, calm scholarly expression, short beard and moustache, and straight dark brown hair pulled back into a low knot at the nape, wrapped with a simple off-white woolen headband. He wears a knee-length saffron-orange wool choga-style robe crossed left over right and secured with a dark brown wool sash, a cream long-sleeved tunic showing at the collar and cuffs, and a loose ankle-length off-white cotton dhoti-style lower wrap, all modest and fully covering the body. A soft slate-grey wool shawl with a thin indigo blue border drapes diagonally over his shoulders and across his torso, one end hanging to mid-thigh. His feet are in simple dark brown leather strap sandals. In his left hand he carries a rolled and partially unrolled palm-leaf manuscript tied with an indigo cord, edges slightly aged, as his constant prop. Use a restrained palette of saffron orange, cream, slate grey, indigo blue and dark brown, and present him front-facing, clearly showing face, hair, headband, layered garments, sandals and the manuscript for consistent redrawing.
